entities.summary: Friedrich Simon Archenhold was an astronomer who founded the Treptow Observatory in Berlin-Treptow. He graduated from the Realgymnasium in Lippstadt before entering Friedrich Wilhelm University in 1882, where he and Wilhelm Förster founded the Urania Society at the Berlin University Observatory.
